# `base/alert-dialog`

Documenting or extending the alert-dialog anatomy itself inside base.

## Selection

- **Use when:** Documenting or extending the alert-dialog anatomy itself inside base.
- **Avoid when:** You are confirming a destructive action in an app — that lifecycle, focus trap and async state belong to ConfirmDialog.
- **Consider instead:** `features/overlays`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { AlertDialogAction } from "themelia-ui/base/alert-dialog"
import "themelia-ui/base/alert-dialog.css"
```

## Composition

This family composes `base/overlay`.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

## Public declarations

### `AlertDialogAction`

Kind: callable.

The affirmative answer. Closes on click unless the handler prevents it.

```text
({ className, ...props }: AnswerProps) => React.JSX.Element
```

## Preview recipes

Preview route: Overlay, dialog & sheet — `/overlay`

### Alert dialog

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<Overlay>
  <OverlayTrigger render={<Button tone="destructive">Delete account</Button>} />
  <AlertDialogContent>
    <OverlayHeader><OverlayTitle>Delete this account?</OverlayTitle></OverlayHeader>
    <OverlayFooter>
      <AlertDialogCancel render={<Button tone="neutral" buttonStyle="outline" />}>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
      <AlertDialogAction render={<Button tone="destructive" />}>Delete</AlertDialogAction>
    </OverlayFooter>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</Overlay>

{/* AlertDialogContent is exactly */}
<OverlayContent
  role="alertdialog"
  dismissal={{ backdrop: false, escape: false }}
  showCloseButton={false}
/>
```
